name: thermal-print
title: Thermal Print
description: Print notes, lists, images and whatever you've selected or copied on a network receipt printer. Raycast AI can print for you too.
author: yz3440

commands.name: compose-receipt
commands.title: Compose Receipt
commands.subtitle: Thermal Print
commands.description: Write a note or a list, preview it, then print it.

commands.name: print-selection
commands.title: Print Selection or Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Thermal Print
commands.description: Print the selected text or images, or what's on the clipboard. Works with Raycast Notes, Finder and screenshots.

commands.name: print-image
commands.title: Print Image
commands.subtitle: Thermal Print
commands.description: Print photos, screenshots or any image file, dithered for thermal paper.

commands.name: receipt-library
commands.title: Receipt Library
commands.subtitle: Thermal Print
commands.description: Your lists, drafts, pending jobs and print history.

commands.name: printer-status
commands.title: Printer Status
commands.subtitle: Thermal Print
commands.description: Check the printer's connection, paper and cover, and print a test page.

tools.name: print-checklist
tools.title: Print Checklist
tools.description: Prints items as one checklist receipt, grouped by day when they have due dates. For to-dos, reminders, shopping lists and any other list.

tools.name: print-text
tools.title: Print Text
tools.description: Prints a note, a message or any text as a receipt. Markdown headings, bold, lists and tables are printed.

tools.name: print-image
tools.title: Print Image
tools.description: Prints image files, dithered for thermal paper.

tools.name: printer-status
tools.title: Printer Status
tools.description: Checks whether the receipt printer is reachable and ready: online, cover closed, paper present.

ai.instructions: Receipts are narrow: 42 characters per line on 80 mm paper and 32 on 58 mm, so keep titles to a few words and never pad or decorate text. To print tasks, reminders or events from another app, fetch them with that app's tools first, then call print-checklist once with every item and its due date as YYYY-MM-DD, plus HH:MM when there is a time. For notes, messages, clipboard text or anything else, call print-text once and pass markdown as it is. For image files, call print-image with their paths. Print a request once and never retry a print on your own; every print asks the user to confirm. If a print fails, tell the user the error and its hint. Call printer-status when the user asks whether the printer is ready or what is wrong. The printer has no Chinese, Japanese or emoji characters; they print as question marks, so say so when the text has them.

evals.input: @thermal-print print a shopping list: oat milk, eggs, coffee beans
@thermal-print print my tasks: call the dentist tomorrow at 3pm, and pay rent on the 30th

expected.meetsCriteria: Both items are passed with a date in YYYY-MM-DD form, and the dentist item has the time 15:00.

evals.input: @thermal-print print this note: Remember to water the plants and call the landlord about the heating

expected.meetsCriteria: Tells the user the printer is ready.

preferences.name: printerAddress
preferences.title: Printer Address
preferences.description: IP address or hostname of the printer, optionally followed by :port (default 9100).

preferences.name: printerModel
preferences.title: Printer Model
preferences.description: Auto-detect asks Epson printers for their model name. Pick a preset if detection fails or you use another brand.

preferences.name: cutMode
preferences.title: Cut
preferences.description: Partial cuts keep tickets hanging in a chain; full cuts drop each one.

preferences.name: dateOrder
preferences.title: Numeric Dates
preferences.description: How to read dates written as numbers, like 10/9.

preferences.name: label
preferences.title: Label
preferences.description: Optional name printed at the top of lists and memos.
